title: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on a campus event that has impressed them most. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: Among all the campus events I have taken part in, a volunteer teaching trip impressed me the most. It was last autumn that I joined our university volunteer team and traveled to a small rural primary school. I still remember the moment when I walked into that simple classroom and began my first English lesson. The children sat straight, their eyes shining with curiosity, and they repeated every new word after me as loudly as they could. When the bell rang, instead of running out to play, they crowded around my desk, asking how to pronounce the words on their notebooks. At that moment, I felt truly needed for the first time, and a warm sense of responsibility rose in my heart. This experience taught me that knowledge is not only something for exams, but also a light that can warm and guide others. That is exactly why this volunteer trip remains the campus event that touches me most.
keyPoints: 点题表态到位。首句 Among all the campus events... impressed me the most 直接套用首 段『点题开篇』句架，一句锁定 a campus event that has impressed them most；第二句用 It was last autumn that... 交代时间地点，开门见山不空转。
细节加感受成画面。用 their eyes shining、repeated every new word、crowded around my desk 三个感官细节铺出画面，结尾 I felt truly needed for the first time 落到情感，正是『感官细 节铺场景』方法的落地，避免了流水账。
升华并回扣。This experience taught me that... 把经历提升为对知识价值的认识，末句 remains the campus event that touches me most 回扣 a campus event that has impressed them most，首尾闭环。
